name: wfgraph
description: Workflow Graph — visual workflow automation with a node-based editor and plugin integrations

scripts.dev:inngest: sh -c 'if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/inngest ]; then export DO_NOT_TRACK=1; exec ./node_modules/.bin/inngest dev --no-discovery -p "${INNGEST_DEV_PORT:-8388}" --connect-gateway-port "${INNGEST_CONNECT_GATEWAY_PORT:-8390}" --connect-gateway-grpc-port "${INNGEST_CONNECT_GATEWAY_GRPC_PORT:-50062}" --connect-executor-grpc-port "${INNGEST_CONNECT_EXECUTOR_GRPC_PORT:-50063}" --persist; else echo "[inngest] inngest-cli is not installed; examples/app.ts sets inngest.connect, so dev:app will fail to boot once its Connect handshake times out"; fi'
scripts.db:generate: pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate --config packages/core/drizzle.config.ts && tsx scripts/unqualify-migrations.ts
scripts.db:generate:sqlite: pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate --config packages/core/drizzle-sqlite.config.ts && tsx scripts/validate-sqlite-migrations.ts
